remarks: This incredible townhome was built in 2004, is in a gated community, and lives like new! Rich, NEW WALNUT FLOORS throughout the home, PLANTATION SHUTTERS, brand new water softener, a custom kitchen island, cathedral ceiling and a STONE FEATURE WALL bring warmth and character rarely found at this price point. This desirable END-UNIT residence lives like a single-family home, with no neighbors above or below and only one shared wall. This home is ideally positioned and tucked in the back of the development. Enjoy the best of indoor-outdoor living with 3 private OUTDOOR SPACES, perfect for catching refreshing ocean breezes. From the primary bedroom and its balcony, take in peekaboo OCEAN VIEWS
